mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.name AS member_name, ct.card_name AS card_type_name, CASE ct.validity_unit WHEN 'MONTH' THEN DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days MONTH WHEN 'YEAR' THEN DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days YEAR ELSE DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days DAY END AS end_date FROM card c LEFT JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.id LEFT JOIN card_type ct ON c.card_type = ct.card_key ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.*, ct.card_name AS card_type_name, CASE ct.validity_unit WHEN 'MONTH' THEN DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days MONTH WHEN 'YEAR' THEN DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days YEAR ELSE DATE(c.create_time) + INTERVAL ct.validity_days DAY END AS end_date FROM card c LEFT JOIN card_type ct ON c.card_type = ct.card_key WHERE c.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.status != 4 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
